DT_PalLongDescriptionText.PAL_LONG_DESC_MushroomDragon_Dark:
The abundance of spores released by this Pal blocks out sunlight.
Sometimes, if <characterName id=|MushroomDragon_Dark|/> appears motionless,
it's not because it's mimicking a mushroom,
but rather because its own spores don't let it see anything.

Sometimes drops <itemName id=|PoisonMushroom| style=|Status_Keyword|/> or <itemName id=|CaveMushroom| style=|Status_Keyword|/> when assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.

DT_PalFirstActivatedInfoText.PAL_FIRST_SPAWN_DESC_MushroomDragon_Dark:
Can be ridden.

While at a base, 
its mysterious spores slow the rate at which the SAN value of allies at the base decreases by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue2}%</>.

Sometimes drops <itemName id=|PoisonMushroom| style=|Status_Keyword|/> or <itemName id=|CaveMushroom| style=|Status_Keyword|/> when assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.
